hypothesis.linear: Frozen embedding linear readout, without incumbent logits
hypothesis.residual: Frozen embedding residual MLP over incumbent logits
hypothesis.late: Train late ResNet and Transformer plus a focal-endpoint readout, preserve all other original decisions
hypothesis.shared_gain: Use shared-gain waveform normalization for the replacement head, then calibrate CODE and Chapman separately
hypothesis.balanced: Use CODE and Chapman training with source/class and patient weighting
hypothesis.hard_positive: Emphasize positive training examples scored below incumbent AFIB cut
hypothesis.rr_temporal: Learn AFIB readout with measured cross-lead RR proxy and missingness, no derived labels
hypothesis.conduction: Combine global embedding with learned local II/V2 temporal pooling, no measured PR claim
hypothesis.hard_negative: Emphasize negative training examples scored above incumbent 1AVB cut

selection: All epochs and arm choices use repeatedly inspected CODE development only, with patient-grouped cross-fitted validation cuts. Stage 1 one seed per eligible arm, then two additional seeds for the highest ranked arm. Priority: CODE class feasibility, CODE calibration, both source guards, source stability, CODE F1/AP, Brier/ECE. Only accept a family with all three seeds passing every guard and all improving CODE F1; retain median F1 seed. No thresholds, checkpoints or gates chosen on historical test data.
sources: CODE train/validation/calibration disjoint; Chapman training pool pre-split by provider group for its own descriptive calibrator in shared_gain only; Chapman validation is transfer/selection diagnostics; CPSC diagnostic only, no patient claims. Source F1 loss limit 0.03 per PR15. Source calibration never uses Chapman validation; reference labels unchanged.
stop: Stop for integrity, budget, three cycles without reproducible incumbent change, or development F1 >= 0.70 with all guards, three seeds and positive lower paired CI. Reused development IC is descriptive only. Do not rerun exact same hypothesis with same incumbent. Never promote without independent confirmation.
working_anchor: A nonpromoted working composite may advance if the three-seed mean improves the same frozen rank; the development incumbent changes only after unanimous class, source and calibration guards plus individual F1 gains. A round without a reproducible working-composite advance counts as stagnant.
scheduler: Nine afterany-linked SLURM slots, at most one cycle per successful slot; each 40-minute one-GPU request, below 12 hours even if every slot times out. Atomic state and fit receipts; one retry for interrupted attempts. Resume completed fit receipts without rerunning.
